component.name: WoW: Forever Addon-Manager
component.summary: Unofficial addon manager for WoW: Forever on Linux
Inoffizieller Addon-Manager für WoW: Forever unter Linux

description.p: Finds the AddOns folder of your WoW: Forever installation (Steam/Proton, Lutris, Wine, Bottles, Heroic), detects installed addons, shows available updates and installs them with a backup. The user interface is in German.
Findet den AddOns-Ordner deiner WoW: Forever-Installation (Steam/Proton, Lutris, Wine, Bottles, Heroic), erkennt die installierten Addons, zeigt Updates an und installiert sie mit Backup.

ul.li: Addon detection via CurseForge fingerprints, GitHub releases as an alternative source
Erkennung per CurseForge-Fingerprint, GitHub-Releases als Ausweichquelle
Version pinning, release/beta/alpha channel per addon, required dependencies
Version festhalten, Kanal je Addon (Release, Beta, Alpha), Pflicht-Abhängigkeiten
Backups of replaced folders and SavedVariables snapshots before every update
Backups ersetzter Ordner und SavedVariables-Schnappschuss vor jedem Update
Optional tray mode with periodic update checks
Optional im Tray mit regelmäßiger Prüfung

description.p: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment or CurseForge/Overwolf.
Nicht verbunden mit oder unterstützt von Blizzard Entertainment oder CurseForge/Overwolf.
Fixes installing and updating addons from the app window, which failed since 0.5.0.
Temporarily disable addons for all characters, view the changelog in the app, and a fix for the empty Advanced menu.
Settings are organized into categories with a sidebar; the header bar no longer shows the title and path.

Update addons before the game starts (pre-launch script or Steam launch option), automatic full snapshots, several WoW installations, error analysis from !BugGrabber, addon sets, hints for abandoned addons and conflicts.
English user interface, AUR package and Flatpak, optional advanced tools (addons per character, cleanup, full snapshots of addons and settings), test suite.
Version selection and pinning, per-addon channels, required dependencies, export/import of the addon list, SavedVariables snapshots and update history.
